note: Composite journey verdict: Project record, business unit, portfolio, manager/department head/sponsor, budget, contingency and Program link all save and are validated. But the derived financial figures never appear, and contract/team/budget-change table rows could not be written through the runtime API.

Composite journey verdict: Activities save with planned/baseline dates and duration is computed; baseline record saves. Dependencies (child table) and status/variance figures did not work, and the Gantt view could not be exercised.

Composite journey verdict: Activities can be assigned and reassigned and the owner is stored, but the 'assigned at' timestamp is not recorded and the assignment notification is switched off with no trigger.

Composite journey verdict: Progress and actual dates save and the weighted value recomputes (1.6 at 40%), but status, schedule variance and the slippage alert do not work (formulas return nothing; alert is a hollow shell).

Composite journey verdict: Issues and action items save with their required details and the critical flag works; days open, overdue flag and automatic escalation return nothing and the escalation/overdue/assignment notifications are not live.

Composite journey verdict: Risks save with their required details and the 5x5 rating computes and recomputes. But the rating band (Critical/High) and the escalation flags are wrong (known chained-formula limit) and the escalation alert to the risk owner is a hollow, switched-off shell, so High/Critical risks are not flagged to governance.
Composite journey verdict: Cost entries save, but the project totals and variance figures never roll up because the roll-ups are wired to the wrong flow; invoices (child table) could not be written.

Composite journey verdict: Manager creates and submits a report and it lands with the Department Head. But the form does NOT insist on the narrative (accepted blank), and the submit notification to the Department Head is a hollow shell.
Composite journey verdict: Could not be tested: sending a report back requires acting as the Department Head/Sponsor, which the single access key cannot do.
Composite journey verdict: Could not be tested: the S-curve is a custom derived view with no REST surface; no S-curve page exists in the native app.
Composite journey verdict: Could not be tested as a Team Member: needs a Team Member identity. Team Member cannot even read Projects (grant missing). Activities save and update as the single user.
Composite journey verdict: Could not be tested: the Department Head approve/return step cannot be completed with the access key (known platform limit).
Composite journey verdict: Could not be tested: the Sponsor step cannot be reached (and the rule deciding whether a report needs the Sponsor never computes).
Composite journey verdict: Could not be tested as a Steering Committee member. The PSC role has no read grant on Projects in the live app, so the portfolio view would be empty for them.
Composite journey verdict: Portfolio report saves with its required period; its project-summary rows (child table) could not be written, and PSR history for other roles could not be viewed.

Composite journey verdict: Holiday and settings records save with required details enforced and settings update correctly. Only the administrator holds access (verified in the live member list, not by acting as other roles).

Composite journey verdict: User/role administration is native to the platform and has no REST exercise here; the live role list was read (7 roles) but account/role changes were not attempted (no mutation allowed).
Composite journey verdict: Audit trail is native; the item-history endpoints tried returned 404 so lifecycle tracing could not be demonstrated programmatically.
